messages:
maria_cs: Drafting a 1-page priming cheat for Aurora (renewal demo). Want ultra-skim for AE: prep, live knobs, consent, quick rollback. PTAL.

sam_eng: Post the tiny checklist here, AE-friendly.

maria_cs: Copy below (very short):
- Goal: predictable demo latency & consistent outputs.
- Leads: CS (maria_cs) + Eng (sam_eng).
- 48h: reserve warm pool sized to 95th pct expected concurrency.
- 6h: run prefill with demo prompts + tenant system prompt variant.
- 1h: dry-run end-to-end with streaming on.
- Live knobs: prefill_ttl_sec=3600, batch_hint {batch_size:8,max_latency_ms:50}, enable_stream=true, stream_fallback_ms=200.
- Obs: verify first-byte <150ms; capture 3 traces.
- Feedback: 3 q survey + opt-in to attach up to 2 anonymized transcripts (consent text below). Link: tiny.redwood/feedback-aurora
- Escalation: if 95th latency >220ms OR hallucination spike -> switch to fallback model variant, rollback prefill, notify CS-oncall + infra.

linda_ae: Can we add one-line for AE: "Risk: renewal sensitive to latency & quality; mitigation: warm-pool + prefill + rollback."

ben_support: GDPR consent copy: "I consent to anonymized transcript review for quality improvements." We'll only attach if customer opts in.

sam_eng: Ops copy - prefill curl (ops):
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/prefill" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"aurora","prompt":"demo-seed","pool_size":10,"ttl_sec":3600}'
```

maria_cs: Pasteable JSON customers can drop into integration: 
```json
{"batch_size":"8","max_latency_ms":"50","enable_stream":"true","stream_fallback_ms":"200"}
```

scheduling_bot: Automated: reserve dedicated capacity 2024-11-24T10:00:00Z for tenant 'aurora'  reply :thumbsup: to confirm.

linda_ae: I'll run dry-run Tue 09:30 with Sam + Ben. After dry-run I'll send this one-pager & survey link to the AE.

maria_cs: Thanks team  saving this thread as the official mini-cheat + snippets + escalation path. :white_check_mark:
